Query Salesforce CRM as the signed-in user

Source: R/backend__salesforce.R
oauth_db_salesforce_api.Rd

Read Salesforce CRM records using the visitor's object, field and record permissions. CRM objects, such as accounts, are queried with Salesforce's query language, SOQL. Queries return data frames for your Shiny app.

Usage

oauth_db_salesforce_api(
  authorization,
  instance_url,
  api_version = "64.0",
  target = NULL,
  required_scopes = "api",
  min_valid_for = 60,
  timeout = 300,
  ca_bundle = NULL,
  session = shiny::getDefaultReactiveDomain()
)

Arguments

authorization

Function providing the visitor's current sign-in authorization. Pass auth$connection from shinyOAuth without parentheses. To select a saved account, use a function calling auth$connection(id).

instance_url

Trusted HTTPS origin of your Salesforce org, such as "https://example.my.salesforce.com". Use the org URL, not a Lightning URL.

api_version

Salesforce REST API version without v, default "64.0".

target

Name of the service token to use in your shinyOAuth client. Named targets let one sign-in obtain tokens for different services. NULL uses the client's default token.

required_scopes

Additional OAuth permissions to check before use. Request them on the shinyOAuth client first; this check doesn't request consent or grant database privileges.

min_valid_for

Minimum remaining token lifetime, in seconds, when obtaining a token. Use 0 to accept any unexpired token.

timeout

Total seconds allowed for an operation, including polling, result pages and any permitted refresh retry.

ca_bundle

Optional path to a trusted CA certificate bundle.

session

The visitor's Shiny session. Usually inferred when you create the helper inside server().

Value

A client object with these methods:

  • $query(soql, include_deleted = FALSE, raw = FALSE) fetches all result pages and returns a data frame. include_deleted = TRUE includes deleted or archived records through QueryAll. raw = TRUE returns combined native records and totalSize, including the count for SELECT COUNT().

  • $objects() returns the API's object catalog.

  • $describe(object) returns field definitions and other object metadata.

Details

Use oauth_db_salesforce_client() for sign-in. Create this API client inside server() and call its methods from render or reactive expressions. The client gets a current token for each request and discards results after sign-out or account changes. GET requests can refresh and retry once after HTTP 401.

Queries fetch all result pages into R memory. timeout applies to the whole operation. Relationships and child-query results stay in list columns; ordinary numbers become R numeric values and large integers stay as strings. Empty results have no field metadata; use $describe() for field types.

Supply SOQL as written. This client doesn't bind SQL parameters or provide a DBI connection. Use raw = TRUE for the records and metadata without conversion to a data frame.

See also

oauth_db_salesforce_client(), oauth_db_salesforce_data_cloud_api(). vignette("salesforce", package = "shinyOAuthDB").

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
crm <- oauth_db_salesforce_api(
  auth$connection, "https://example.my.salesforce.com"
)
output$rows <- shiny::renderTable({
  crm$query("SELECT Id, Name FROM Account LIMIT 20")
})
} # }
